releaseName: Cover letters checked by a second model
summary: Saving a cover letter now queues one check by a critic from another company (OpenAI by default). It quotes the sentences that read as machine-written, and the author revises the letter once (#2527, #2528, #2529, #2530). A revision that still passes every citation rule opens as the next version, with what the critic flagged; otherwise your draft stands. The Prepare panel says while the check runs and how it ended (#2531). Edited versions and interview questions are never checked. Earlier in this milestone: saved drafts, guidance, the writing check, the model picker, voice samples, editing and Word/PDF export.
knownLimitations: The critic check runs only when the record's consent names both Anthropic and OpenAI, and the workspace's critic is from another company than the author. It costs at most US$0.30 a letter. The research brief before drafting (#2482) waits on the choice of a web search provider, and the blind test of writing models (#2483) has not run. Drafting still needs DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude route on staging. Beta invites have no routes or screen yet, and the spend pool is off unless configured. Agents cannot approve or export, and saved drafts are not yet reachable from agents. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The local-first desktop has no career interview or Prepare panel.
